title: Priority change priority-change.kp.codex-reliability-before-product-v0
summary: Bounded reliability priority is complete; successor checkpoint now restores the approved product frontier

sourceRefs.intent: Temporarily prioritize Codex execution reliability, approval hygiene, explicit stop semantics, and durable loop progress. After this bounded reliability tranche, resume the preserved product sequence in order: presentation scheduling and responsive attention, structured algebra, fraction composition pressure test, governed semantic and LLM authoring, then symbolic and cross-domain breadth.
